context: Two cafe friends gossip about a near-miss confession
purpose: Teach: ひょっと/あふれる/出来れ/なにしろ/ちょっぴり/がっかり/あわて/感触

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえねえ、聞いた?昨日リクくん、ひょっとしたら告白するかもって噂だったでしょ。
lines.en: Hey, did you hear? There was a rumor Riku might confess yesterday, right?
lines.style: Conspiratorial whisper between close friends sharing juicy gossip

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 聞いた聞いた!私もうドキドキで、想像するだけで胸に何かがあふれる感じだった〜。
lines.en: I heard, I heard! I was so excited my heart felt like it was overflowing.
lines.style: Dreamy and emotional tone with bubbly romantic enthusiasm

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でもさ、結局言えなかったらしいよ。出来ればちゃんと伝えてほしかったのにね。
lines.en: But apparently he couldn't say it in the end. I wish he'd properly told her.
lines.style: Slightly disappointed sigh with mild frustration toward the situation

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、なにしろ初めての告白だったから、緊張しちゃったんじゃない?
lines.en: Aw, after all it was his first confession, so he probably got nervous, right?
lines.style: Sympathetic defending tone, soft and understanding of nerves

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まあね。でも彼女のほう、ちょっぴり期待してたみたいで、ちょっとがっかりしてたよ。
lines.en: I guess. But she had been a little hopeful, so she was kind of disappointed.
lines.style: Reporting insider information with a knowing matter-of-fact tone

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ああ〜切ない!でも目が合った瞬間、手が触れた感触で何か伝わったかもよ?
lines.en: Oh, how heartbreaking! But the moment their eyes met, maybe the touch conveyed something?
lines.style: Overly romantic and theatrical, painting a dramatic scene

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃんロマンチストすぎ(笑)。リクくん、最後あわてて帰っちゃったらしいよ。
lines.en: Mei, you're way too much of a romantic, lol. Riku apparently rushed home in a panic.
lines.style: Teasing laugh between friends with affectionate ribbing

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もう〜!次は絶対うまくいくって信じてる。応援しよ?
lines.en: Geez! I believe next time it'll definitely work out. Let's cheer them on, okay?
lines.style: Bright, hopeful and encouraging with shipper energy
